import warnings

# Set environment variables for reproducibility

torch.manual_seed(42)
np.random.seed(42)
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

# Paths setup
TRAIN_DIR = "./input/train"

SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"

labels_df = pd.read_csv(LABELS_FILE)
train_ids = labels_df["id"].values
train_labels = labels_df["breed"].map(model_names).values


# Define data loader class
class DogDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, image_dir, ids, labels, transform=None):
        self.image_dir = image_dir
        self.ids = ids
        self.labels = labels
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.ids[idx]
        path = os.path.join(self.image_dir, img_id + ".jpg")
        img = cv2.imread(path)
        if img is None:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Image not found: {path}")
        img = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)

        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)

        label = self.labels[idx]
        if label not in model_names:
            label = model_names[0]  # fallback
        idx_label = model_names.index(label)
        target = torch.tensor([int(idx_label)], dtype=torch.long)

        return img, target, img_id


# Transforms

# Create dataset splits

val_end = val_start + n_val
test_start = val_end
test_end = total_train_samples

    TRAIN_DIR, train_ids[val_start:val_end], train_labels[val_start:val_end]
)
train_dataset = DogDataset(TRAIN_DIR, train_ids[:val_start], train_labels[:val_start])
test_dataset = DogDataset(TEST_DIR, [], [], [])  # Test dataset for loading only

test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=16, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)


# Simple model architecture
class SimpleDogClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_classes=120, channels=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv_layers = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, 32, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(32),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1)),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(128, n_classes),
        )
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.5)

    def forward(self, x):
        out = self.conv_layers(x)
        out = out.view(out.size(0), -1)
        out = self.dropout(out)
        out = self.conv_layers.out(out)
        return out


model = SimpleDogClassifier(n_classes=120).to(device)
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
    optimizer, mode="min", factor=0.5, patience=2
)

best_val_loss = float("inf")
patience_counter = 0

epoch = 1

    train_losses = []
    val_preds = []

    model.train()
    for i, batch_data in enumerate(
        train_loader := DataLoader(
            train_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=True, num_workers=0
        )
    ):
        imgs, targets, _ = batch_data
        imgs, targets = imgs.to(device), targets.to(device)

        outputs = model(imgs)
        loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        train_losses.append(loss.item())

    scheduler.step(min(train_losses))

    print(f"Epoch {epoch} Complete, Best Val Loss so far: {best_val_loss:.4f}")

def compute_log_loss(predictions, targets, model_names):
    probs = (
        np.array(predictions)
        / sum([np.sum(p, axis=0) for p in predictions])[:, :, np.newaxis]
    )
    true_labels = targets
    log_probs = np.log(probs[np.arange(len(true_labels)), true_labels.astype(int)])
    return -np.mean(log_probs)
